description: This Town of Cary layer records 1,476 items of street furniture as points, each with a furniture type, facility id, install date, condition, owner, maintainer and repair notes. The furniture types are memorial and regular benches, candidate bench locations, bike fix-it stations, bike racks, bollards, drinking fountains, gates, pet waste and recycling receptacles, public art, signs and trash receptacles. It is served from the town's ArcGIS server and listed on the Wake County open data hub. Coverage: the Town of Cary in Wake County, North Carolina. Access: free through the ArcGIS FeatureServer and hub downloads. Licence: none stated on the hub record. Caveats: one town's asset register, so types and condition codes are local; the hub page has no description. Simulation uses are street-level public realm inventories for maintenance, accessibility and storm debris planning, and inputs to pedestrian comfort models. Related records: OpenStreetMap and the Mapillary street-level imagery used to map street furniture elsewhere.
